title: TinyViT-5M live camera latency on DE1-SoC
description: Mean of 20 timed frames per mode using the same ARM runner, two HPS threads, and a 640 × 480 MJPEG feed requested at 30 fps. DMC1 improved MNN inference by 1.52× and JPEG receipt to logits by 1.43× versus original FP32 CPU. The timing difference includes JPEG decoding, preprocessing, and runner communication. The board report lists the raw CSV locations and reproduction commands.
